initial_decision.brief_rationale: The population table and numerical verification establish the standardized contrast but provide no causal identification assumptions. Please retrieve archived design record R296-3 to assess whether that contrast identifies the requested average causal risk difference.

final_decision.brief_rationale: The design record establishes conditional exchangeability, consistency, no interference, and positivity. Standardizing the stratum-specific risk differences over the population distribution of Z identifies the causal effect: (250/350)(0.4−0.6) + (100/350)(0.8−0.6) = −0.08571428571428572.
